correctness.rationale: Strict convexity of inverse-trace on connected Laplacians proves the global optimizer unique, allowing cycle reflections to force two edge-rate classes; disconnected boundaries diverge. Exact four-cycle series/parallel resistances and articulation identity yield K=ΣC_j(t_j)/b_j. The quartic derivative numerator has one positive simple zero by Descartes and endpoint coercivity, and Cauchy--Schwarz fixes all budgets. A standalone package verifier passed 1078 assertions with 52 exact-rational full graph checks; the proof, not finite tests, establishes all k and positive prices.

value.rationale: A natural Dutch four-cycle windmill network with heterogeneous edge-class prices receives an exact unrestricted solution: one uniquely positive shape root per cycle and an explicit cross-cycle budget rule. The equal-price within-cycle hub-to-distal ratio is nontrivial and grows from √2 at k=2 toward √3; no edge class is optimally removed. This structural outcome and exact implementable design are not merely a recomputation of a single fixed-graph index or a generic SDP statement.
